images.title: Eight lines, eight 45° angles
images.purpose: Show four straight lines through one centre, making eight equal angles of 45°.
images.composition: A single centre point in the middle of the frame with eight rays spreading out evenly.
exact_structure: One centre point in the middle of the frame.
One horizontal and one vertical dark line through the centre, making four right angles.
Two teal (#0072B2) lines through the centre that bisect those right angles, so there are 8 rays in all.
All 8 neighbouring rays are 45° apart; one of the 8 angles has a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle arc and the label 45°.
Exactly 8 small amber (#E69F00) petal shapes, one between each pair of neighbouring rays, all the same size.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Bisecting a right angle gives 45°, and eight 45° angles fill the full turn.
images.description: Show four straight lines through one centre, making eight equal angles of 45°.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: The design itself is visual; students need to see the eight equal angles.
